theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_restriction_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsRestriction T A S) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsRestriction T A S → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), CompactlyContainedOpen W U → S.massOn W < ∞
